headers.//: Files under /assets keep stable, unhashed names, so without this a returning visitor re-downloads every photo and the hero video on each visit. The flip side: replacing an image reuses its filename, so rename the file (or purge the Vercel cache) when swapping one, or browsers will hold the old copy for a year.
Vite fingerprints these filenames on every build, so a new deploy produces new URLs and the old ones are safe to cache indefinitely.
